instruction: Buy me any t-shirt in my size on amazon. Assure from QAs/reviews that no one has reported its color fading after washing. Obtain my size from any of my past t-shirt orders.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The user's size is discovered by listing past purchases, picking a past t-shirt and reading its relative_size via show_product (modeled as known-size). search_products filtered by product_type=t-shirt and relative_size then yields the candidate; reviews and question answers must be checked (reviews-checked, qa-checked) before add_product_to_cart, which additionally requires the static world fact no-fading-reported so only the fading-free product can be ordered. clear_cart_first=true is passed so the new order contains exactly one item with quantity 1. The order must ship to the home address (is-home-address) discovered via show_addresses; the address is never modified. supervisor.complete_task takes the order record parameters (no API answer) and is forced last.

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-1 home-address amazon-token candidate-tshirt quantity-1 new-order)
